title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-11 08:31:16 最新章节：第1413章 前往中天域
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“小师妹，你偷吃的是我的鸡…吧！
？”
“小师妹，你怎么又来偷吃？”
“小师妹，别来了，真的要没有了！”
三天了，三天了！
整整三天，林东方都没有把心心念念的熏鸡做成。
都扑倒在熏制之前的最后一步！
“啊呜啊呜。”
“咕噜咕噜。”
“吸吸索索。”
林东方的小屋外，一位绝美的红头发少女正坐在凉亭里抱着一只三斤多重的卤鸡咔咔啃。
恶狠狠的咽下香喷喷的鸡肉，她脸上漾起满足的笑容，一对小酒窝更显得小脸娇俏可爱。
石桌上有一大碗卤汤，油汪汪的汤上还飘着她自己撕碎的葱花和香菜。
豪迈的喝了一口鸡汤，少女美滋滋的摇头晃脑享受了一下，头顶的一小缕呆毛来回摆动。
继续啃！
连骨头都嗦的干干净净。
别说留下一丝肉了。
连鸡腿骨关节处的软骨都咔咔给嚼了。
一对小虎牙无往不利！
林东方一边看着少女摧残他的鸡，一边回想着他这惨淡的穿越开局。

他本是地球上，某一家六星级小饭馆的行政大厨。
在替老板陪着老板娘度假的时候，玩了一下悬崖蹦极。
结果绳子断了！
然后他连人带魂穿越到了这修炼界北斗星。
当然了，老板娘因为没有玩蹦极，所以没跟着穿越来。
他倒是不是因为馋老板娘身子，而是馋陪老板娘出来玩才有的年终奖。
但那些都是浮云了！
林东方穿越之后正好赶上这南域六大圣地之一的瑶池圣地收徒大会！
他身材高大，相貌也是浓眉大眼英俊潇洒。
穿越之后更是恢复到了十八岁的巅峰时期。
一下子就被一个九千多岁的女长老相中了。
于是领去测试。
根骨天赋为‘仙’！
也被称为‘仙苗’！
整个瑶池圣地都炸锅了！
野生的仙苗可不多见！
然后在圣主的亲自护送下，林东方去测试‘道’，确定修炼方向。
刹那间，漫天的锅碗瓢盆虚影。
仙药级别的蒜头大葱生姜虚影更是异彩纷呈。
天地间更是响起了切菜，炒菜，烹炸的声音，听了就让人流口水。
content_en:
"Little junior sister, what you stole was my chicken... right?
? "
"Little junior sister, why are you here to eat secretly again?"
"Little junior sister, don't come, we are really going to die!"
Three days, three days!
For three whole days, Lin Dongfang failed to make the smoked chicken that he had been longing for.
All thrown at the last step before smoking!
"Ahhhhhh."
"Gulu gulu."
"Suck the rope."
Outside Lin Dongfang's hut, a beautiful red-haired girl was sitting in the pavilion, holding a three-pound braised chicken and gnawing.
Swallowing the fragrant chicken fiercely, a satisfied smile appeared on her face, and her pair of dimples made her face even more cute and cute.
There is a large bowl of stewed soup on the stone table, and the chopped green onions and coriander that she has torn up are floating on the oily soup.
Taking a bold sip of the chicken soup, the girl shook her head happily and enjoyed it, with a small strand of hair on her head swinging back and forth.
Keep chewing!
Even the bones are clean.
Not to mention leaving a trace of meat.
Even the cartilage at the joints of the chicken leg bones was chewed up.
A pair of little tiger teeth can do no harm!
While Lin Dongfang watched the girl destroying his cock, he recalled his dismal beginning of time travel.
He was originally the executive chef of a six-star restaurant on Earth.
When I was on vacation with my boss's wife for my boss, I did some bungee jumping off a cliff.
The rope broke!
Then he traveled across time and soul to the world of cultivation, Big Dipper.
Of course, the boss lady didn’t travel through time because she didn’t do bungee jumping.
It's not because he is greedy for the boss's wife's body, but because he is greedy for the year-end bonus that can only be obtained by hanging out with the boss's wife.
But those are all clouds!
After Lin Dongfang crossed over, he happened to catch up with the disciple recruitment meeting of Yaochi Holy Land, one of the six holy lands in the Southern Territory!
He is tall and handsome with thick eyebrows and big eyes.
After traveling through time, he returned to his peak age of eighteen.
Suddenly he was attracted by a female elder who was over 9,000 years old.
So I took it for a test.
The root bone talent is ‘immortal’!
Also known as ‘fairy seedlings’!
The entire Yaochi Holy Land is in a state of shock!
Wild fairy seedlings are rare!
Then, under the personal escort of the Holy Lord, Lin Dongfang went to test the 'Tao' and determine the direction of cultivation.
In an instant, the sky was filled with shadows of pots and pans.
The elixir-level garlic, green onions and ginger are even more colorful.
The sound of chopping, stir-frying, and frying vegetables could be heard from heaven to earth, which made people drool.
